name: Regal Fang Canal
introDiscord:
A narrow royal canal passes beneath old hunting lodges and decorative
bridges.

Regal Fang Morays have inherited the king's private waterways.
introTwitch:
A narrow royal canal passes beneath old hunting lodges and decorative
bridges.

Regal Fang Morays have inherited the king's private waterways.

regal-fang-canal-approach.prompt: Regal Fang Canal opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A Regal Fang Moray emerges beneath a bridge.

right.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's little fishing rod.

'Fishing attempt:

Moray tried catching ME.

Sport cancelled.'

forward.message: A hunting lodge chest contains Star Candies.

regal-fang-canal-depths.prompt: Deeper within Regal Fang Canal, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: An old lodge cabinet contains restorative supplies.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Moray circles beneath the canal.

forward.message: A royal tackle chest contains Star Candies instead of bait.

regal-fang-canal-threshold.prompt: Near King's Hunting Canal, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A bridge alcove hides a decorative coffer.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle says:

'Fishing recovery.

No fish acquired.

One boot lost.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Regal Fang Moray guards King's Hunting Canal.

boss-antechamber.name: King's Hunting Canal
boss-antechamber.prompt: The canal ripples beneath a crown-shaped bridge.

bossPromptDiscord:
The canal ripples beneath a crown-shaped bridge.

One enormous jaw passes underneath.

Use /yes to continue the royal fishing expedition or /no
to preserve your remaining footwear.
bossPromptTwitch:
The canal ripples beneath a crown-shaped bridge.

One enormous jaw passes underneath.

Use !yes to continue the royal fishing expedition or !no
to preserve your remaining footwear.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from King's Hunting Canal. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Crown-Fang retreats beneath the bridge.

Shizuki's missing boot is not recovered.

The case grows cold.
